observations: Vintage-style sewing machine with a black head and yellow decorative decals.
The machine is mounted on a wooden table with a cast iron stand and treadle wheel.
The table has two drawers on either side of the central motor compartment.
The machine head is marked 'MADE IN THE PEOPLE'S REPUBLIC OF CHINA' in English and Chinese characters.
A small motor is attached to the left side of the head.
The treadle wheel and foot pedal are visible at the base.
The wooden table shows some wear and scuffs.

claims.evidence: The brand name 'BUTTERFLY' is clearly visible on the machine head in photo 3.
The presence of a treadle wheel (manual) and a motor (automatic) is shown in photos 0, 1, 2, and 3.

claims.claim: It Comes With An Automatic Motor
claims.evidence: A motor is attached to the left side of the machine head in photo 3.

risks.risk: The motor may be non-functional or have a burnt-out motor.
risks.proof: A video showing the motor running and the machine sewing through a piece of fabric.

risks.risk: The treadle mechanism may be jammed or the foot pedal may be broken.
risks.proof: A video showing the treadle wheel being turned and the foot pedal being used to operate the machine.

risks.risk: The needle and bobbin may be missing or damaged.
risks.proof: A photo of the needle bar and the bobbin area.

risks.risk: The machine may have internal rust or mechanical wear.
risks.proof: A video showing the machine being operated and the internal mechanisms moving smoothly.

proof_requests: Video of the motor running and the machine sewing through fabric.
Video of the treadle wheel and foot pedal being used.
Photo of the needle and bobbin area.
Photo of the underside of the machine head to check for rust.
response.reason: The item is clearly identified as a Butterfly sewing machine. It can be priced at its worst-case value (non-functional) until proof of operation is provided.
